definition: A finite set of elements together with relations over them, possibly with labels and distinguished elements. Distinct from any representation of it in memory.

short: A concrete layout of a structure in memory (cells, pointers, bit strings). Costs belong to representations, not to struc
definition: A concrete layout of a structure in memory (cells, pointers, bit strings). Costs belong to representations, not to structures.

short: Machine model with $w$-bit words, $w \ge \log_2 n$, unit-cost word operations and random access
definition: Machine model with $w$-bit words, $w \ge \log_2 n$, unit-cost word operations and random access; an operation on a $b$-bit integer costs $\lceil b/w \rceil$ steps.

definition: The separation of every request into syntax (is it well formed and admissible?), semantics (what does it denote?) and execution (what does it cost?).

short: A tuple $(\Sigma, \Str, \sem{\cdot}, \Lang)$ of moves, a structure, relational semantics and an admissibility language.
definition: A tuple $(\Sigma, \Str, \sem{\cdot}, \Lang)$ of moves, a structure, relational semantics and an admissibility language.

short: A grammar whose unique derivation is the structure itself, such as a minimal DAG or a straight-line program.
definition: A grammar whose unique derivation is the structure itself, such as a minimal DAG or a straight-line program.

short: The finite set of operations (moves) of a structure, each with an arity.
definition: The finite set of operations (moves) of a structure, each with an arity.

short: A formal language constraining which move words may be executed
definition: A formal language constraining which move words may be executed; it constrains the projection of a word onto the moves it mentions.

short: The meaning of a move as a relation between states
definition: The meaning of a move as a relation between states; words mean compositions and languages mean unions.

short: Agreement of a representation's execution with the reference semantics, including the point at which an expression becom
definition: Agreement of a representation's execution with the reference semantics, including the point at which an expression becomes undefined.

short: The tuple $(T_{\mathrm{build}}, S, T_{\mathrm{query}}, T_{\mathrm{update}}, |\mathrm{out}|)$ of a resolution scheme.
definition: The tuple $(T_{\mathrm{build}}, S, T_{\mathrm{query}}, T_{\mathrm{update}}, |\mathrm{out}|)$ of a resolution scheme.

short: The shortlex-least move word reaching an element from a root
definition: The shortlex-least move word reaching an element from a root; for trees, the root-to-node word over $\{0,1\}$.

short: An injective map from addresses to natural numbers
definition: An injective map from addresses to natural numbers; arithmetic if moves act on numerals by cheap arithmetic.

definition: The number of elements divided by the size of the range of a numeration; density $1$ means an array of exactly $n$ slots suffices.

definition: The conjecture that every asymptotic advantage of a grammatical scheme is attributable to the five mechanisms.

definition: Search on pairs (element, automaton state) to resolve language-constrained queries; at most $|Q| \cdot n$ states.

definition: A grammar such as $P \to E \mid E\,P$ whose least model is the transitive closure of a graph.

short: The structural grammar of a tree with one node per distinct subtree.
definition: The structural grammar of a tree with one node per distinct subtree.

definition: The number of queries $Q^* = B/(q_0 - q_1)$ after which an index with build cost $B$ pays for itself.

definition: A scheme answering a family of queries without access to the structure needs at least $\log_2 N$ bits, where $N$ is the number of distinct answer functions.

short: A representation from which answers are read without consulting the original structure.
definition: A representation from which answers are read without consulting the original structure.

short: The average cost per operation over a worst-case sequence of operations
definition: The average cost per operation over a worst-case sequence of operations; it does not bound individual operations.

short: The stationary distribution of a damped random surfer with teleportation and a dangling-page convention.
definition: The stationary distribution of a damped random surfer with teleportation and a dangling-page convention.

short: The probability $\alpha$ with which the random surfer follows a link rather than teleporting.
definition: The probability $\alpha$ with which the random surfer follows a link rather than teleporting.

short: A page with no out-links
definition: A page with no out-links; its probability mass must be redistributed by a stated convention.

short: Repeated application of the PageRank map
definition: Repeated application of the PageRank map; it contracts the $L_1$ error by $\alpha$ per step.

short: A random surfer on the product of a labelled graph with a DFA over labels
definition: A random surfer on the product of a labelled graph with a DFA over labels; its vertex marginals are the constrained ranks.

definition: The request/response contract cgt-gaas/0.1: versioned grammars, layered rejection, counted-cost quotas and provenance hashes.

definition: Every comparison sort needs $\lceil \log_2 n! \rceil$ comparisons on some input.

short: The words over push/pop whose prefixes never pop more than they push: the defined stack-operation sequences
definition: The words over push/pop whose prefixes never pop more than they push: the defined stack-operation sequences; context-free, not regular.
